description: This is a shell script used for testing the 'git rebase --fork-point' functionality, including setup of test repositories, executing various rebase scenarios, and verifying expected outcomes.

methods.name: do_test_rebase
methods.description: Performs a rebase operation on the 'side' branch, resets to specific commits, and compares the log output to expected results.

methods.name: test_rebase
methods.description: Wraps 'do_test_rebase' with a test expectation, providing a descriptive string.
